description: This file declares a cTimer class that provides timer functionality, including starting, stopping, detaching, joining, and setting intervals for callback functions. It manages a thread internally to perform timed callbacks.

classes.name: cTimer
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a timer using a thread to execute callback functions at specified intervals.

methods.name: cTimer
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the timer object.

methods.name: ~cTimer
methods.description: Destructor to clean up the timer object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer thread; returns false if thread couldn't be started.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer thread; the user should call join() or detach() afterward.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the timer thread to run independently.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the timer thread to wait for its completion.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is active.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the callback function and interval for the timer.
